description: This file defines the 'SizeNode' class which extends 'PcbNode'. It models a size specification with width and height attributes, and provides a constructor to initialize these from a list of children elements, as well as a 'toString' method for representation.

classes.name: SizeNode
classes.description: Represents a size attribute of a PCB element with width and height values.

methods.name: SizeNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the size node with given name, index, and children elements; parses size values from children list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SizeNode object.
